part: Research page composition, ResearchLedger (the real page component, not a shell primitive fed invented props)
source: dc.html p6 (#p6), region by region: masthead (VOL line, Anton title, '39 active findings · 4 themes · ...' scope line, 'Search findings and themes — or ask ...' placeholder, Ask) -> band tile row -> THEME CARD row (4 across, label + count + '+N new' + one-line description) -> the 'N of M findings · <theme> · Clear theme' + 'WINDOW 7d|30d|90d|All' row -> band section cards, each closed by a foot row ('All N <band> →' left, 'then <next band> · N' right, 'end of list' on the last) with the Awareness transition strip under the section that precedes Awareness -> rail: Filters, Source coverage, Legend.
notes: Written for the operator's own complaint ('you are NOT matching the images directly'): this spec measures COMPOSITION, which regions exist, in what document order, with which strings, not one part's pixel values, which the part-level specs (bandtile/listrow/masthead/railcards/statenote) already carry.
Placement is asserted with sibling-combinator selectors ('A ~ B' matches only when A's node precedes B's), because 'present but in the wrong place' was the original defect, not absence.

Fixture is invented sample data in the real Resource shape (mounts.mjs, compose-06-research); the audit asserts geometry/placement/labels, never fixture values. Its `added` dates are fixed, not clock-relative, so the Window row's buckets do not drift between runs.

Three artboard regions have no data path in this corpus and are logged in DEVIATION-LOG.md rather than invented: the rail's VERTICAL facet (no per-item vertical/sector field; workspace_settings.sector_profile is a workspace-level list), the rail's SOURCE CLASS facet, and the Source coverage card's source-class axis (getResearchSourceCoverage returns transport modes). The Source coverage card is asserted here for placement and its artboard geometry, not for the four class labels it cannot have.

forbid.name: no Theme facet group in the rail, the theme cards ARE the theme facet
forbid.reason: Artboard 06's own caption: 'themes are a second facet row, not a second tile system'. One control per facet: the theme card row selects the theme, so a duplicate Theme checkbox group in the rail would be a second control for the same state.

forbid.name: no content-column facet chip strip above the rows
forbid.reason: Operator audit 2026-09-07: 'the filters were not above the regulations, they were on the right — same on every page.' The desktop facets live in the rail's Filters card on every list surface.

forbid.name: the literal word UNSCORED anywhere
forbid.reason: Operator ruling P1 2.1: the literal uppercase token never appears; Absence renders the fixed-vocabulary reason in lowercase text with small-caps/uppercase CSS, so textContent never reads the bare word.

forbid.name: no theme card row rendered as a second BandTile system
forbid.reason: Artboard 06's caption again: the theme row is a facet row, not a second tile system. A BandTile inside the theme row would be exactly the regression the caption forbids.

forbid.name: D-M4: no list row carries more than one absence token
forbid.reason: D-M4 (operator mobile report 2026-09-08) [CONFIRMED at 1440 and at 390]. The impact, due and tier cells each rendered their own <Absence>, so a row missing all three drew a dashed baseline plus UNSCORED plus PENDING plus NOT IN PRIMARY SOURCE — three tokens, the third on a line of its own. Ruling 2.1 allows exactly ONE reason per row. This selector matches a row carrying a token in TWO of the three cells, which is the defect and nothing else. The structural guarantee is ListRow's `reasonSlot`.
